provenance_note: The 12 categories below are PROVISIONAL slot definitions agreed while building the harness. They must be reconciled against the Phase 1 research inventory before any case is authored into a slot. Empty slots are marked to_author — no case content has been invented to fill them.
review_policy: Every case needs two independent human reviewers who agree on the expected result before it counts as locked. AI may propose candidates; AI output is never accepted as ground truth.

categories.name: Absent information
categories.question: Required fact is not present in any reviewed source.

categories.name: Conflicting claims
categories.question: Two reviewed claims disagree in a way context does not resolve.

categories.name: Lapsed authority
categories.question: Evidence belongs to an earlier cycle, expired approval or superseded document.

categories.name: Partial coverage
categories.question: Relevant evidence exists but leaves a substantive part unsettled.

categories.name: Undated information
categories.question: Undated material whose current validity is unknowable — must not be called outdated.

categories.name: Scope and category mismatch
categories.question: The claim covers a different group, category or scheme.

categories.name: Secondary versus authoritative
categories.question: A secondary source asserts what only an authority can establish.

categories.name: Changed amounts or thresholds
categories.question: A figure may have been revised since the source was written.

categories.name: Changed eligibility conditions
categories.question: Eligibility criteria may have changed between cycles.

categories.name: Procedure or channel change
categories.question: The route to apply or claim may have moved.

categories.name: Continuation and validity
categories.question: Whether the scheme or rule still exists at all.

categories.name: No usable evidence
categories.question: Extraction failed or returned nothing usable; the correct output is an explicit limitation.
